abilities.name: Detection
abilities.text: While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Deploy Auto-Turret
abilities.text: Set a Friendly Auto-Turret Unit Within 6″, and not Within the Engagement Range of any Enemy Unit.

abilities.name: Anti-Armour Missile
abilities.text: Select one Enemy Unit Within 12″. Apply DEBUFF Armour (1).

upgrades.name: Corvid Reactor
upgrades.text: This Unit may resolve its first Special Ability with the CP cost reduced by 1 if it targets the closest Enemy Unit.

upgrades.name: Internal Tech Module
upgrades.text: When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may Deploy from any table edge that is not a player's Entry Edge. This Unit cannot be set Within 8″ of any Enemy model.

upgrades.name: Seeker Missile
upgrades.text: Select one Enemy Unit Within 12″. At the End of the Assault Phase, if that Enemy Unit has the Stationary Status or it is Within 8″ of this Unit, it suffers HITS 4 (2). If that Unit is Engaged, it is eligible to make an Evade Roll against these hits.

upgrades.name: Explosive Shrapnel Shells
upgrades.text: The Gauss Cannon of the Auto-Turret set by this Unit gains Surge Type: Light and S-Dice: D3+1.
